selection_rule: Maximize dev exact-evidence Hit@3, then Hit@1, then lower chunk count; alphabetical tie-break. Freeze before test.
split: First 15 development, last 5 test; same book and topics, so topic leakage and small sample limit generalization.
coherence_sample: First ten selected physical pages, character position floor(page length / 2), chosen before retrieval.
human_review_status: Pending; AI-drafted benchmark and audit sheets require student review. Do not tune using test.
evidence_review: Evidence spans corrected for completeness before any test retrieval; no test scores used.
